segments.title: How many countries are in the UN?
segments.say: How many countries are members of the United Nations? Comment your answer. Three. Two. One.

segments.title: Almost EVERY country
segments.sub: Each one gets **a vote** in the General Assembly
segments.say: That's almost every country on Earth, and each one gets a vote in the General Assembly.
